verdict.rationale: Nix documents per-project reproducible development environments via `nix-shell`, `nix develop`, and flakes. Builds see only explicitly declared dependencies, multiple versions can coexist, and the docs claim that a package working on one machine will work on another. Community users confirm relying on Nix for specific library versions per project and for hash-verifiable reproducible builds. However, the pack never shows an explicit pinning mechanism, so exact-version pinning is implied rather than documented. missing for 10: documented lockfile or exact-version pinning mechanism (e.g. flake.lock or a pinned nixpkgs revision), explicit evidence that pins are respected across updates, hands-on corroboration of pinning specifically.
